claim_text: Delta weight-and-balance outage was a cyberattack
summary: No source says the outage was a cyberattack. Delta calls it a technical or automation issue and gives no cause. The FAA says only that the delays are not related to FAA air traffic systems.
detail: The FAA statement rules out its own systems, not an attack on Delta. We found no Delta or FAA statement either confirming or denying a cyberattack, and no claim of one by anyone. The desk found no explicit no-indication statement, so the label stays Not established.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Reports quote Delta calling it a technical issue and the FAA ruling out only FAA systems; neither addresses an attack.
notes: Sweep note mentioned a blog saying a Delta spokesperson suggested no cyberattack; not verified, left out.

claim_text: Delta's weight-and-balance automation system went down on Sunday
summary: Delta says an outage in the system that calculates aircraft weight and balance delayed its flights on Sunday, Nov 22. Crews used manual workarounds while automation was restored.
detail: Simple Flying names the system as the Automated Load Instruction System (ALIS). ABC reports Delta said it was a technical issue with one of its weight and balance systems.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Several outlets, each quoting Delta and the FAA advisory, report the outage; Delta statements are quoted verbatim by ABC, WSB-TV and Fox.
notes: Delta newsroom checked (search API): no statement posted. Confirmed rests on Delta statements quoted by outlets plus FAA advisory reporting.

claim_text: FAA stopped Atlanta-bound Delta flights at Delta's request
summary: The FAA issued a ground stop for Delta flights bound for Atlanta Sunday morning at Delta's request, then eased it to a Delta-only ground delay just after 8:40 AM ET, outlets report.
detail: WSB-TV cites an FAA advisory saying the original stop was issued at Delta's request and that the carrier-only delay followed. Simple Flying cites the FAA's status page. NBC reports the delay program applied to Delta and its regional carriers.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Independent outlets cite the FAA advisory and the FAA status page for the same stop and downgrade.
notes: FAA advisory itself not retrievable after the fact; read via press.

claim_text: FAA ended the Delta ground delay at 11:26 AM ET
summary: NBC News reports the FAA lifted its ground delay program for Atlanta-bound Delta flights at 11:26 AM ET. Delays continued afterward.
detail: Fox News says the ground delay stayed in effect for Delta after the stop was lifted, per the airport, without giving a time. WSB-TV and Atlanta News First had the delay expected until at least 1 PM, written earlier.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet gives the 11:26 AM time; no FAA document read directly.

claim_text: Delta says automation is working again
summary: WSB-TV and Atlanta News First report Delta said its weight-and-balance programming was working again. WSB-TV posted the report at 3:48 PM ET Sunday.
detail: Delta also apologized, said it was rebooking customers and offering meals, hotels and refunds, and said it was still finishing the day's schedule.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Both outlets relay one Delta statement; we did not find it on Delta's newsroom.

claim_text: More than 1,600 Delta flights were delayed
summary: ABC News reports, citing Delta, that more than 1,600 Delta flights were delayed Sunday and about 49% of all Delta flights were more than 15 minutes late. Other counts differ.
detail: Fox News says at least 3,500 flights were reportedly delayed, and WSB-TV says an FAA advisory projected more than 3,500 delays. NBC cites FlightAware: 997 Atlanta flights delayed and 26 canceled by 1:55 PM ET. The counts measure different things.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: ABC's updated story (4:43 PM ET) attributes the 1,600 figure and the 49% figure to Delta; an earlier version said 1,300.
notes: AP page blocked (403); only search snippet read.

claim_text: About 70% of Delta delays and cancellations tied to the automation issue
summary: Delta says about 5,000 Delta and Delta Connection flights were scheduled Sunday and about 70% of delays and cancellations were tied to the automation problem. The rest were weather and Northeast air traffic programs.
detail: Delta said FlightAware counts of delays and cancellations are accurate, per WSB-TV and Atlanta News First.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Both outlets relay one Delta statement.

claim_text: The FAA says the delays are not related to FAA air traffic systems
summary: The FAA said Delta was working to resolve its weight and balance automation system and that the delays are not related to any FAA air traffic systems. ABC, WSB-TV and Fox quote it.
detail: The FAA statement is a post on X, quoted by outlets; we did not read the post. It says nothing about the cause of Delta's outage.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Three outlets quote the same FAA statement; counted as one source.
notes: Social post is Tier 4; read through press.

summary: Delta has not said what caused the outage. Delta describes a technical issue and an automation issue; Simple Flying says the cause was not disclosed.
detail: No Delta or FAA root-cause statement, and no independent finding, was found as of the last check.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Outlets report Delta gave no cause.
notes: Root cause needed before any closure.

claim_text: Link to the FAA nationwide ground stop of Nov 13
summary: ABC and NBC mention the FAA's Nov 13 nationwide stop as context only. No source says it is connected to Delta's outage.
detail: ABC attributes the Nov 13 stop to an equipment installation problem. Delta's system is separate from FAA air traffic systems, per the FAA. See the FAA ground stop page on this site.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Outlets present the FAA stop as background; none links the two.

claim_text: Link to the United Airlines weight-system outage of Nov 16
summary: NBC and Simple Flying mention a similar United outage as context. No source says the two are connected.
detail: NBC says United's Nov 16 outage disrupted crew communications and final aircraft weight data, per the pilots union, and that United resolved it that day. Simple Flying says it lasted more than 90 minutes.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Outlets note a similar failure but do not link cause.
